label: external_log_snapshot
command:
bash -c $'
  set -u -o pipefail
  output=$1; identity=$2
  find log -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > "$output"
  aggregate=$(sha256sum "$output" | awk "{print \$1}")
  count=$(wc -l < "$output"); bytes=$(du -sb log | awk "{print \$1}")
  printf "aggregate=%s count=%s bytes=%s\n" "$aggregate" "$count" "$bytes" > "$identity"
  cat "$identity"
' _ /home/dev/ws_iap/src/iap/results/icra27/icra031/prechecks/attempt_02/external_log_before_files.sha256 /home/dev/ws_iap/src/iap/results/icra27/icra031/prechecks/attempt_02/external_log_before_identity.txt

label: process_precheck
command:
bash -c $'
  set -u -o pipefail
  task_root=$1; declare -A excluded=(); ancestor=$$
  while [ "$ancestor" -gt 1 ] && [ -r "/proc/$ancestor/stat" ]; do excluded[$ancestor]=1; ancestor=$(awk "{print \$4}" "/proc/$ancestor/stat"); done
  matches=0
  for proc_path in /proc/[0-9]*; do
    pid=${proc_path#/proc/}; [ -n "${excluded[$pid]:-}" ] && continue
    [ -r "$proc_path/cmdline" ] || continue
    cmdline=$(tr "\0" " " < "$proc_path/cmdline" 2>/dev/null) || continue
    case "$cmdline" in *"$task_root"*) printf "%s\t%s\n" "$pid" "$cmdline"; matches=$((matches + 1));; esac
  done
  printf "task_process_matches=%d\n" "$matches"; test "$matches" -eq 0
' _ /home/dev/ws_iap/src/iap/results/icra27/icra031
